## Design

### 2026-10-05 – Started work on my first PCB project. I’m getting the hang of KiCad, sort of. It’s a bit confusing but I think I can learn it. I started by reading the guide and struggling a bit to get the mods into

**1h**

Started work on my first PCB project. I’m getting the hang of KiCad, sort of. It’s a bit confusing but I think I can learn it. I started by reading the guide and struggling a bit to get the mods into KiCad, but after some googling and finagling, I managed to get it all into KiCad (I hope). I then  began work on the actual schematic. I had to start over a few times and had to google how to use some stuff, but I managed to get the microcontroller part done.

### 2026-10-06 – Since I now have a better understanding of KiCad, I made the schematics for the rest of the parts of the project. There are some parts that I’m not fully sure about, but I’ll cross those bridges when

**0.5h**

Since I now have a better understanding of KiCad, I made the schematics for the rest of the parts of the project. There are some parts that I’m not fully sure about, but I’ll cross those bridges when I get to them. Next session, I’ll be CADding up the actual PCB.

### 2026-10-08 – I spent way too long figuring out why the footprint things on the PCB editor weren’t working and lost more than a few brain cells and about a quarter of my sanity googling and trying stuff and rereadi

**1h**

I spent way too long figuring out why the footprint things on the PCB editor weren’t working and lost more than a few brain cells and about a quarter of my sanity googling and trying stuff and rereading the instructions and yeah you get the gist. I may have danced around my room when I finally got everything to work, and then I had to figure out how to move individual components. I then started work sketching the shape of the board, and that’s where I left off.

### 2026-10-11 – ![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/zgx6E5ybAqbc7sxF1tycd9i0oPMDKdpt/8508076d7a6ee5f62010c33535c9d8d3b7c302219f8bb726074a457f1e1525a4.jpg)

**4h**

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/zgx6E5ybAqbc7sxF1tycd9i0oPMDKdpt/8508076d7a6ee5f62010c33535c9d8d3b7c302219f8bb726074a457f1e1525a4.jpg)

I made the board shape and drew the traces today. I first did the star but then just did a rectangle because I didn’t like how it looked. Then went through and drew the traces. I’m not confident I did it completely but it looks close enough I guess. I then put the files into the GitHub repo and started making the Bill of Materials. Also downloaded Arduino IDE to get started on the code. I think it’s too late at this point to finish this before the week is over.
